# BYTE MAIT

> BYTE is the technical society at Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology (MAIT), Delhi. We build projects, explore research, host and participate in hackathons, and create space for students to learn with one another.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://bytesoc.dev/): About BYTE, achievements and upcoming events
- [Projects](https://bytesoc.dev/projects/): Projects built by the society
- [Events](https://bytesoc.dev/events/): Workshops, talks, hackathons and visits
- [Members](https://bytesoc.dev/members/): The core team and department members
- [Recruitment tasks](https://bytesoc.dev/tasks/): Department tasks and submission details for joining BYTE
- [Contact](https://bytesoc.dev/contact/): How to reach the team

## Projects

- [EZCrack](https://bytesoc.dev/projects/ezcrack/)
- [HopOff!](https://bytesoc.dev/projects/hopoff/)
- [BunkMAIT](https://bytesoc.dev/projects/bunkmait/)
- [Scrape2Sim](https://bytesoc.dev/projects/scrape2sim/): Turns public robot-component product pages into an evidence-backed 3D assembly and MuJoCo simulation
